recent.emptyBody: Open {address} on the iPhone, or point the camera at the QR code in Connect.
recent.noMatchBody: Try another filter or search term.
send.dropSub: or click to choose — they show up on the iPhone right away
send.qrBody: Open the camera, tap the link and go to From the PC. Files go to the Files app → Downloads.
connect.noNetworkBody: Connect this PC to the same Wi-Fi as the iPhone (or to the same router with a cable).
connect.iphone1: Open the Camera and point it at the QR code.
connect.iphone2: Tap the link. The KromaDrop page opens with the access code already filled in.
connect.iphone3: Tip: tap Share → Add to Home Screen to get an icon like an app.
connect.otherTitle: Another computer on the same network
connect.otherHead: Windows, Mac or Linux, nothing to install
connect.otherHeadSub: Works in any browser: Chrome, Edge, Safari or Firefox
connect.other1: On the other computer, open the browser and type {address}
connect.other2: The first time, enter the access code {code}. Or send the link with the code by chat or email:
connect.other3: To send to this PC: drag files onto the page or click it to choose. They land in the folder set in Settings.
connect.other4: To receive from this PC: drag files onto this window. They appear under From the PC on the other computer's page; just click Download.
connect.otherHelp: Didn't open? Check that both are on the same Wi-Fi or router, that this PC's network is set to Private in Windows settings, and that the firewall allowed KromaDrop.
connect.shortcutHeadSub: Create it once in the iPhone Shortcuts app
connect.shortcut1: In the Shortcuts app, tap +. Under ⓘ Details, turn on Show in Share Sheet and accept Images, Media and Files.
connect.shortcut2: Add Repeat with Each using the Shortcut Input.
connect.shortcut3: Inside the repeat, add Get Contents of URL with the URL below, and at the very end insert the variables Repeat Item → Name, a dot and Repeat Item → File Extension:
connect.shortcut4: Under Show More: Method POST, Request Body File → Repeat Item.
connect.shortcut5: Name it {name}. Done: on any photo or file, tap Share and pick the shortcut.
connect.shortcutHelp: If the PC's IP changes, the QR code updates by itself but the Shortcut doesn't. To keep the IP fixed, reserve it in your router (DHCP reservation).
server.portInUse: Port {port} is already in use. Choose another one in Settings.
settings.byDateSub: Creates a subfolder like {example} for each day
settings.reveal: Show the file when it arrives
settings.revealSub: Opens Explorer with the file selected
settings.languageSub: The iPhone page follows the phone's language
settings.notificationsSub: Let me know when a file arrives
settings.launchSub: Opens minimized in the tray, ready to receive
settings.tray: Keep running in the tray when closed
settings.traySub: Closing the window doesn't stop receiving
settings.codeSub: Generating a new one disconnects every device
settings.footer: KromaDrop {version} · works only on your local network, nothing goes through the internet
toast.newCode: New code generated. Scan the QR code again on the iPhone.
toast.onlyFiles: Only files can be shared, not folders.
